Chip art: Calvin in Metal4 (30.0 x 36.5 um, 0.5 um pixels) between the first and second pair of power
stripes, on the bottom 10 rows (away from the pins at the top). librelane_plugin_glyph_art.py cuts those rows
(the keep-out in macros/CALVIN/art.json; no cells, taps, filler or Metal1 rails there) and merges the
art cell into the GDS; the obstructions keep the router off the patch on every layer. make art rebuilds it.
The resizer otherwise buffers high fan-out nets and the inputs with dlyb_1 delay cells (5 ns each at the
slow corner, and 3 times the area of a buf_1); without them it uses real buffers.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
The pixel clock is 39.72 ns (25.175 MHz). The flow only repairs timing at the typical corner,
so it is hardened at 30 ns: the slow corner (125C, 3.0V) then comes out at 32.6 ns.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
